formats.lineage_rule: Hash the authored file and provider-rendered mdout.mdp separately; mdout.mdp does not replace the authored plan.
Hash the root, every include, force-field directory identity, and processed topology.
Treat all transitive includes and conditional definitions as one closure.
Record atom/site order, optional velocities, box and numeric precision.
PDB chemistry/protonation/bonding is not a complete GROMACS force-field topology.
Hash exact group membership and record every selected name/number.
Bind exact grompp version, mdp, coordinates, topology closure, index, checkpoint input and transcript.
Bind parent run, step/time, TPR, output checksums, executable/build and known algorithm-specific limitations; portability does not guarantee bitwise continuation.
Require a matching version banner, one logical segment, final step/terminal semantics, and no adverse marker.
Bind to TPR/run segment; preserve native precision and term names.
Positions only; record frame cadence, precision, atom selection, PBC and segment continuity.
May contain positions, velocities and forces; prove actual fields rather than infer them from the extension.
Record contained data, compression and producer version.
2026.3 support is experimental; record exact producer/consumer and do not assume trjconv/trjcat output support.
Bind command, selections, time window, units and raw native source; an XVG alone is not provenance.

fail_closed_rules: Never load an untrusted binary artifact with an unpinned provider.
A filename or extension does not prove fields, units, completeness, or lineage.
Preserve raw run artifacts before any conversion, concatenation, centering, or PBC transform.
H5MD support newly added in 2026.3 remains experimental and must be labeled accordingly.
